## Core definitions

### Phone farm
A hardware setup running multiple real Android smartphones in parallel with centralized power, cooling, and USB routing — for mobile QA, app testing, automation, creator studio workflows, and digital marketing device labs.

### Phone farm box
Factory-built 2U chassis housing up to **20 real Android devices** with centralized PSU, active cooling, and managed USB/ADB connectivity. Replaces scattered desk chargers. Standard dimensions: **21.26 × 14.37 × 7.28 in** (540 × 365 × 185 mm), ~**13 lb** shipping weight.

### Cell phone farm / mobile farm
Synonyms for phone farm — multi-device real smartphone hardware operated at scale.

### Motherboard cluster
Headless Android motherboards (no screen/battery) in dense chassis for maximum node count — suited for headless app QA.

### Visual Android device command center
Single-screen mirroring, batch grouping, bulk APK push, and node health monitoring — built from ADB tools + optional workstation setup. PhoneFarm Fun supplies hardware; software is vendor-neutral.

## Chipset selection guide

- **Exynos 7420 / Android 7 entry** — first lab pilots, budget under $500 ($428 tier)
- **Snapdragon 835 (S8 Reliable $620 / S8+ $699)** — efficient 24/7 stable automation
- **Snapdragon 845 (N9 Pro $998 / S9+ $942 / Note 8 $857)** — multi-app & heavy QA
- **Snapdragon 855 (S10+ $1220)** — development & intensive test labs

## FAQ quick answers (54 total — full page: /faq)

**What is phone farm equipment vs a phone farm box?** Equipment = full category (chassis, PSU, devices, accessories); box = factory 2U 20-node unit.

**2U phone farm rack vs desk setup?** 2U factory chassis has centralized PSU/cooling/USB; desk chargers overheat — see /blog/rackmount-2u-phone-farm-rack-buyer-guide

**Wholesale / bulk order?** MOQ 1 for evaluation; volume pricing from 5 units — contact /contact

**What is a phone farm box?** Factory 2U chassis with 20 real Android devices, centralized power/cooling/USB.

**Chassis size & weight?** 21.26×14.37×7.28 in; ≈13 lb (6 kg) empty chassis — see /faq procurement table.

**Voltage & power draw?** 110V–220V AC; PSU 450–550W; typical load ≈280–380W at 20 nodes.

**How many boxes per PC?** Usually one box per control PC; two possible with powered USB3 hub — ask sales.

**Pre-shipment photos?** Yes on request after burn-in — contact form checkbox or Telegram/WhatsApp.

**Packaging?** Foam-lined export plywood crate + QC sheet + commercial invoice.

**Warranty & if broken?** 12-month assembly warranty; DOA within 7 days; RMA per /warranty.

**Where to buy?** phonefarm.fun — factory-direct from Guangzhou.

**Who manufactures in China?** PhoneFarm Fun — local assembly since 2017, burn-in QC, export worldwide.

**Real device vs cloud phone?** Real farms = physical hardware you control; cloud = shared virtual instances.

**Creator studio workflows?** Hardware supports parallel Android devices; platform compliance is operator responsibility.

**Prevent crashes/overheating?** Use factory chassis not desk chargers; centralized PSU + active cooling + burn-in.

**Budget under $500?** Exynos N5 entry from $428 + shipping.

**Bulk APK install?** ADB loop across serials from control PC — see /blog/bulk-apk-installation-guide

**Batch device automation / mobile device labs?** 20-node factory chassis + optional ADB batch setup — see /blog/phone-bot-farm-mobile-farm-hardware-guide

**Best manufacturer 2026?** Compare factory-direct QC, tiers, export — PhoneFarm Fun Guangzhou since 2017.

**Software included?** ADB-ready hardware; optional remote/group setup service; no proprietary lock-in.
